title: XMAX Starry V4.0 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The XMAX Starry V4.0

The Starry 4 is designed to enhance your vaping experience for dry herbs (concentrate capable).

The Starry 4 comes with an adjustable airflow system, allowing you to control the amount of air that flows into your device. This feature not only enables you to customize your vaping experience, but it also helps to prevent any clogs or obstructions.

You can also flip the OLED screen 180 degrees, providing you with greater flexibility and convenience. Perfect for left or right-handed smokers! The Starry 4 comes equipped with three session timers. This allows you to select your preferred temperature, time, and session duration, making it easier than ever to control your vaping experience! ery failure, you have the option to replace it on your own.

Product Features:
– Adjustable Airflow
– Smart OLED Screen Flip
– Three Session Timers
– Replaceable 18650 2550mAH battery
– Jewelry-grade zirconia mouthpiece

What’s Included:
1 x Starry 4.0 Vaporizer
1 x USB-C Cable Charger
1 x Dosing Capsule
1 x Cleaning Tool
1 x Packing Tool
1 x Brush
2 x Mouthpiece O-rings
2 x Chamber Mesh Screens
2 x Mouthpiece Silicone Cap
3 x Cotton Swabs
4 x Alcohol Cotton Pads
1 x User Manual
1 x Gift Box

*Extra 18650 batteries sold separately*
